name: should create and publish a new Mira AI agent via onboarding

steps.name: Verify URL redirected to dashboard after login
Verify AI Automations navigation is visible
Verify Product news button is visible
Verify "Connect additional channels" heading is visible
Verify Connect Email card is visible
Verify Connect Live Chat card is visible
Verify Connect Messenger card is visible
Verify Connect WhatsApp card is visible
Create Mira AI agent via onboarding flow
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Verify created Mira AI agent is visible in the list and name matches
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes have been saved successfully.').first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes saved successfully and chatbot has been published.').first()
Configure behavior sliders: tone, talkativeness, confidence and emoji
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Re-open editor and verify behavior slider values are persisted
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Open skill: Handover to an operator
Click locator('label.chakra-radio').filter({ has: locator('p').filter({ hasText: 'Never handover to an operator' }) }).locator('span.chakra-radio__control')
Select handover option: Never handover to an operator
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes have been saved successfully.').first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes saved successfully and chatbot has been published.').first()
Configure handover: set to "Never handover to an operator" and publish
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Open skill: Handover to an operator
Expect "toHaveAttribute" locator('label.chakra-radio').filter({ has: locator('p').filter({ hasText: 'Never handover to an operator' }) })
Verify handover option is set to: "Never handover to an operator"
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes have been saved successfully.').first()
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Changes saved successfully and chatbot has been published.').first()
Change welcome message language to Czech and publish
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Verify welcome message language is set to "CS - Čeština"
Re-open editor and verify welcome message language is persisted
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Close removal survey popup if visible
Toggle bot switch at index 0 to OFF
Verify bot at index 0 is disabled (OFF)
Toggle the agent OFF and verify it is disabled
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Publish anyway' })
Handle "not installed" popup — click Publish anyway
Toggle bot switch at index 0 to ON
Verify bot at index 0 is enabled (ON)
Toggle the agent back ON and verify it is enabled
Navigate to AI Chatbots page and verify page loaded
Open first AI Assistant options menu
Delete Mira AI agent at index 0
Verify no AI agents are present
